Deep-space assembly points."<br />"And hidden Alliance bases.|[[Eurrsk Thri'ag|Eurrsk "Grinder" Thri'ag]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''Project Morrt''' was a covert operation carried out by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Apwar Trigit]], under the command of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].

Named for the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Morrt|parasite]], Project Morrt commissioned the creation of the [[Morrt-class parasite-droid|''Morrt''-class parasite-droid]], an espionage [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with a tracking system for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] movements.

The ''Morrt'' droids would attach themselves to various ships and track their movements over time. The droids would occasionally detach from a ship and move to another, in order to map [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] traffic patterns. These patterns would then be used to determine the deployment of [[empion mine]]s.

Upon detonation, the empion mine would send a signal to Zsinj's forces, which would be investigated by a Zsinj-allied ship like [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']] or [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']]. During one of these ambushes, [[Wraith Squadron]] was able to capture ''Night Caller'' and learn the nature of Project Morrt. The New Republic then located the ''Morrt'' droids infesting their [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|fleet]], and used them to create a false traffic pattern which would lure Zsinj's forces into a trap.

Although intelligence analyst [[Gara Petothel]] was able to detect the New Republic's misinformation, Wraith Squadron was still able to lure Zsinj's ships ''[[Provocateur]]'' and ''[[Constrictor]]'' into a trap and destroy them in the [[Morobe system]]. This event marked the end of Project Morrt.
